name: Supernatural Spirits
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid seeking guidance from familiar spirits and wizards, as doing so defiles and turns people away from God’s authority (Leviticus 19:31; Isaiah 8:19). Instead, God calls His people to seek Him alone rather than attempting communication with the dead. In contrast, the Bible affirms the existence of ministering spirits sent by God to serve and protect those who will inherit salvation, highlighting the divine purpose of supernatural spirits aligned with God's will (Hebrews 1:14).
